resisted: Nothing structural. Much hidden structure is excess: most ReLU units see one z-scored one-hot input, so each is a two-valued offset (race:4 chain, race:1 chain, 10971->3077 relay). Hub 350 is a 16-entry lookup table including a memorised rule (native-country:4, 64 rows, +10.4 logit). Category names inferred from PMLB alphabetical coding.
tool_bugs: None. Compositions list only their own nodes in subgraph_nodes. compute_shap (500) ~17 min.
summary: logit P(income<=50K): bias + eight disjoint additive terms. Mostly linear: household block (marital, relationship, sex) largest (ablation AUC 0.910 -> 0.853), then numeric terms and category offsets. Three nonlinear pockets: a one-knot capital-gain ReLU; a youth gate (below-median age, threshold moved by Handlers-cleaners); hub 350, an off-switch shared by Exec-managerial, Farming-fishing, Doctorate, Without-pay and Armed-Forces. Train acc 0.854, AUC 0.910.
